pkgmetadata.longdescription: Qoder is Qoder's agentic coding desktop application. It pairs an AI agent workbench with file and session management, built on Electron. This package installs the prebuilt upstream binary tree from the official deb payload.
Qoder 是 Qoder 推出的智能体编程桌面应用, 以编程智能体为核心, 基于 Electron 构建。本软件包安装官方 deb 载荷中的上游预编译 程序目录。
